title.value: Heat Safety in the Workplace: Modified Delphi Consensus to Establish Strategies and Resources to Protect the US Workers

scope_reason: The paper addresses occupational heat stress and its health and productivity impacts on US workers and issues consensus heat safety recommendations.

scope_quote.evidence_text: Heat safety recommendations were created to protect worker health and to avoid productivity losses associated with occupational heat stress.
